# SCI-MAP v0.1 r0.7 Implementation-Blind Horizontal Audit

Scope: frozen SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5; SCI-VAL Core v0.1/r0.3 and the exact
continuing Registry/Source-Binding Register revisions; frozen SCI-AST v0.1/r0.3
ALIGN-grid original-occurrence and RTC-output-grid coordinate authorities;
`SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1`; SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7;
`SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2`; and
`SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@1`.

The audit inspected only scientific authorities enumerated by
`SOURCE_MANIFEST_R0.7.md`. It did not inspect implementation, schemas,
configuration, tests, reductions, validation evidence, generated science
products, production behavior, or historical defaults.

| Audit route | Disposition | Basis and remaining gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Internal contract coherence | Coherent as a conditional owner-review packet | Quantity, stable occurrence, signal and original-footprint coordinates, ordered gates, one-hot projection, exact MAP operator, response families, covariance states, and atomic coadd ownership compose without conflict |
| 2. Source closure | Closed for the enumerated document packet | Both PTC/MAP boundary copies are byte-identical; all three views import the same shared authority and owner ledger; exact Registry/source-binding/profile/boundary paths and digests are enumerated. This is document source closure only |
| 3. Conditional estimator authority | Defined | Positive-coefficient observation estimator and equal-observation centered-integer coadd have exact conditional authority; PTC coefficient truth and MAP admission remain separate |
| 4. Numerical observation-map route | Unavailable | `PTC-OD-010` selects no MAP-facing coefficient family and `SCI-MAP-OD-007` admits no exact numerical `coverage_cut` state |
| 5. Response-bearing science-map route | Conditional; no general numerical response established | Fixed-state, PTC full-procedure, PTC+MAP re-resolved, and exactly-once PTC-grid companion roles are distinct. Whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP response is unavailable. Each claim still requires an exact sufficient response |
| 6. Uncertainty-qualified route | Conditional; no general complete covariance established | Complete covariance requires every term/block for the selected role. Partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, and unavailable states remain honest alternatives; missing is not zero |
| 7. Compatible-grid coadd route | Conditionally coherent | Requires source-bound member maps and an eligible realized `observation_coadd_admission@1` decision. Base response-independent coadd accepts advisory/unavailable response; response/covariance qualification is role-specific |
| 8. Reprojection/mosaic route | Unavailable and not authorized | Centered-integer identical-grid placement is the only coadd geometry. `SCI-MAP-OD-009` and a separate scientific contract remain required |

Cross-package checks bind the PTC and MAP copies of
`SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1` byte-identically. The continuing VAL records
retain `map_upstream_admission@1` as immutable historical authority, bind `@2`
and coadd `@1` to the exact r0.7 sources, and retain VAL as evaluator/registry
rather than policy author. The PTC coefficient/QC decision cannot rescue MAP
admission. No flag or cause gains universal MAP action. No direct CAL,
PTC-disabled, inferred-no-op, cross-generation, descendant-coordinate
exposure, fractional-projection, crop/pad, reprojection, or mosaic route is
introduced.

Result: no scientific inconsistency was found within this bounded conditional
packet. This does not close either numerical hard gate and makes no claim of
implementation conformity, validation, achieved response, observational
performance, scientific freeze, readiness, or production authorization.
